messages:
jess: triage note - found a clean repro for duplicate POSTs from the kotlin sampleapp when doing streaming gzip uploads on emulator API 33. server logs show two uploads, second with refreshed token.

jess: minimal flow: streaming RequestBody -> socket write throws EPIPE -> Authenticator runBlocking refresh -> OkHttp connection-retry also enqueues retry -> two attempts. sample snippet in app uses a streaming GzipSink.

kai: yep this is the classic overlap: OkHttp internal retry + Authenticator follow-up. Streaming bodies aren't rewindable so retries are unsafe. quick fixes: disable retryOnConnectionFailure for upload client, or provide a small rewindable prefix buffer (8KB) so short retries can be handled.

omar: also recommend single-flight token refresh (mutex) outside the Authenticator if possible. Authenticator is synchronous so runBlocking there can block OkHttp threads and worsen races.

jess: plan: (1) update sampleapp to set retryOnConnectionFailure=false for upload client, (2) add devex doc note about streaming+auth interactions, (3) include prefix-buffer snippet and a Mutex-based refresh example. will open PR and add an emulator test in CI matrix.

ci-bot: CI: reproducible-upload-race branch failed on emulator-14 matrix - see UploadRetryRaceTest in job 5234.

kai: thanks, that sounds good. also log the workaround in the sample README so integrators don't accidentally copy streaming+auth naive pattern. :thumbsup:
